welcome.title: Welcome to Harvests!
welcome.subtitle: The leading African agricultural platform
welcome.intro: Congratulations! Your Harvests account has been created successfully. You are joining a dynamic community of producers, processors and consumers who are transforming African agriculture.
welcome.verify_prompt: To activate your account and start exploring everything Harvests has to offer, please verify your email address by clicking the button below:
welcome.warning_text: This verification link expires in 24 hours. If you don't use it in time, you will need to request a new verification link from the login page.
welcome.profile_intro: To keep sign-up simple, we only asked for the bare minimum. To place orders or sell on Harvests, please complete the following details in your profile the first time you sign in:
profile_items: Your phone number (required for delivery tracking)
Your business details (farm, company or restaurant)
welcome.features_title: Once your account is activated, you will be able to:
features: Publish and manage your agricultural products
Connect with other players in the sector
welcome.ignore: If you didn't create a Harvests account, you can safely ignore this email. No action is required on your part.

password_reset.title: Password reset
password_reset.subtitle: Harvests - Your account security
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your Harvests account. This request was made from our platform.
password_reset.prompt: If you made this request, click the button below to create a new, secure password:
password_reset.warning_text: This reset link expires in 1 hour to keep your account safe. Please act quickly!
password_reset.security_text: If you didn't request this reset, please ignore this email right away. Your current password remains unchanged and your account is secure.
tips: Never share this link with anyone
Use a strong, unique password (at least 8 characters)
Mix letters, numbers and special symbols
Sign out of any devices you don't recognize
password_reset.support: If you keep having trouble signing in, or you think your account has been compromised, contact our support team immediately.

account_approval.title: Congratulations!
account_approval.subtitle: Your Harvests account is approved

account_approval.access: You now have access to all the features reserved for professionals. You can start managing your business, publishing your products and connecting with other members of the community.
account_approval.closing: We are delighted to have you with us and look forward to seeing your business grow on our platform.
